meta.name: teammode
meta.description: Codex-only team orchestration: run a named team of cooperating Codex threads with durable, script-managed state. MUST USE when the user asks Codex to create, run, coordinate, inspect, archive, or delete a team of threads/sessions, or to work on something as a team in parallel. The main session is always the leader; members are defined by a concrete part, ownership area, or perspective - never a vague job role; a bundled cross-platform script writes the .omo/teams state plus an auto-generated member field manual. Use a team when the work is not perfectly isolated but parallelizing helps, or when a task still needs exploration under a clear goal; use plain subagents when scope is perfectly isolated or the goal is ambiguous. Triggers: team mode, teammode, make a team, run as a team, team of agents, coordinate threads, parallel Codex threads, archive the team, delete the team.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编排多个 Codex 线程并行协作完成任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Codex 中协调多个线程并行处理复杂工作。
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate multiple Codex threads to collaborate in parallel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to coordinate multiple Codex threads to work in parallel on complex tasks.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会作为团队领导，创建并协调多个 Codex 线程（成员）并行工作，管理团队状态，分配任务，验证结果，并最终整合产出。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建、运行、协调、检查、归档或删除一组线程/会话，或要求以团队形式并行工作时触发。

say.text: 创建一个名为“项目A”的团队，包含两个成员：前端和后端。
say.note: Claude 会初始化团队，添加成员，并创建对应的线程。

say.text: 为团队“项目A”添加一个成员，负责数据库设计。
say.note: Claude 会运行脚本添加成员并生成手册。
Claude 会通知成员并清理团队状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a team leader, creating and coordinating multiple Codex threads (members) working in parallel, managing team state, assigning tasks, verifying results, and synthesizing the final output.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create, run, coordinate, inspect, archive, or delete a team of threads/sessions, or to work on something as a team in parallel.

say_en.text: Create a team named "Project A" with two members: frontend and backend.
say_en.note: Claude will initialize the team, add members, and create corresponding threads.

say_en.text: Add a member to team "Project A" responsible for database design.
say_en.note: Claude will run the script to add the member and generate the manual.
Claude will notify members and clean up team state.
